description: Defines the PortfolioAccountDTO class, a Data Transfer Object for portfolio account data in the Fineract project, including account details and constructors.

classes.name: PortfolioAccountDTO
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing portfolio account information, including account type, client ID, currency, account status, deposit type, and group ID.

methods.name: PortfolioAccountDTO
methods.description: Constructs a PortfolioAccountDTO with all details including account type, client ID, currency, account status, deposit type, and whether to exclude overdraft accounts.

methods.name: PortfolioAccountDTO
methods.description: Constructs a PortfolioAccountDTO with account type, client ID, and account status, defaulting other fields.

methods.name: PortfolioAccountDTO
methods.description: Constructs a PortfolioAccountDTO with account type, client ID, currency, account status, and deposit type, defaulting overdraft exclusion.

methods.name: getAccountStatus
methods.description: Returns the array of account statuses.

methods.name: getFirstAccountStatus
methods.description: Returns the first account status from the array.

methods.name: isExcludeOverDraftAccounts
methods.description: Indicates whether overdraft accounts are excluded.
